data.title: The Announcement for BCC Distribution
data.body:
Dear all,

Binance will open the channel for BCC/BTC trading on 3pm August 2nd, 2017 ( Beijing time). In order to ensure the security of your assets, the transferal & withdrawal time will be announced after the blockchain is stable.

  1. About Bitcoin Cash(BCC)
  2. Fees
  3. Rule

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

August 2nd, 2017
